svg.title: The right eye of MaleCNS, before and after the dorsal-rim orientation
svg.desc: Each dot is one of the 892 columns of the right eye, placed at its modelled azimuth and elevation. Red dots are the dorsal-rim columns. Left: the lattice with the medulla's dorsal axis vertical, the rim runs diagonally from the front of the equator to the top back. Right: turned by 60 degrees, the rim lies along the top of the eye.
